content: MK reports that Qāsim-i Anvār was never the subject of an independent hagiography because of his perceived failure to control his disciples, a failure to which Ṣāʾin al-Dīn himself refers explicitly (see §8.3), and that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's two letters to him appear to be the only direct evidence of their relationship; their tone is warm and one speaks of several days spent in his company.
refers_to_primary: Bashir, Sufi Bodies, 146; Munshaʾāt-i Turka letters 37-38
